value.answer: A few things help at almost any age: keep the same short wind-down every time (dim lights, a book, a song), put him down drowsy but still awake so he learns to drift off on his own, and watch for tired signs like rubbing eyes or getting fussy so you don't let him get overtired. A dark, quiet room and white noise help too. How old is he? The right nap window and length change a lot from month to month.
